storyCards.headline: I Want To Know What Love Is: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Foreigner's "I Want To Know What Love Is" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 21 weeks on the chart.

I Want To Know What Love Is was released in 1985.

"I Want To Know What Love Is" by Foreigner.

Chart story — peaked at #1 on the Hot 100.
